text: Six months into the war with Iran, Americans are still feeling its impact at the pump. Gas prices are around $4.00 a gallon nationwide. The July jobs report revealed an unexpected loss of 23,000 jobs, missing economists' forecasts.
translated_text: 与伊朗的战争已经进行了六个月，美国人仍然感受到了战争对加油站的影响。全国汽油价格约为每加仑 4.00 美元。 7 月份就业报告显示意外减少 23,000 个工作岗位，低于经济学家的预测。

text:
Soccer star Lionel Messi attended the funeral of his late father, Jorge Messi, in Rosario, Argentina, on Sunday.
Jorge Messi died Friday night at age 68 at a medical clinic in Rosario after a long illness.
translated_text:
足球明星莱昂内尔·梅西周日出席了在阿根廷罗萨里奥举行的已故父亲豪尔赫·梅西的葬礼。
豪尔赫·梅西 (Jorge Messi) 因长期患病于周五晚上在罗萨里奥的一家医疗诊所去世，享年 68 岁。

text: Sen. Bill Cassidy of Louisiana said on Sunday that his decision to support Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general wasn't "black or white," outlining what informed his thinking ahead of casting the decisive vote.
